decisions.identity: Heterogeneous ore commodity, not mineral species, aluminium element, refined alumina or red mud.
decisions.designation: EU original 2024/1252 Annex I 1(a), strategic, and Annex II 1(c), critical; recital 8 explicitly names the ore in the combined value chain.
decisions.mechanism: none accepted; study access/interpretation limits below

decisions.identity: Refined aluminium oxide commodity; no specific crystalline phase or HPA grade imposed.
decisions.designation: Same original EU combined designation as explicitly named intermediate product.
decisions.mechanism: none accepted; total Al from mixed catalyst is not phase-specific alumina evidence

decisions.identity: Purity-defined refined Al2O3 product; GA describes white crystalline powder and 99.99% purity. This is not kaolin or raw HPA feedstock.
decisions.designation: Australian Critical Minerals List, exact 20 February 2024 update, Table 1.
decisions.mechanism: No primary grade-achieving microbial product result accepted within checked coverage.

decisions.identity: Canadian ore/concentrate category for green steel, distinct from elemental or high-purity metallic iron. No universal numeric cutoff asserted.
decisions.designation: Canadian list updated 2024, dated announcement 10 June 2024.
decisions.mechanism: No grade-specific microbial evidence accepted within checked coverage.

decisions.identity: Commercial borate raw materials including ores and refined borates, with boric acid as distinct associated product.
decisions.designation: BGS/CMIC UK 2024 Criticality Assessment OR/24/059 Table 11, not government policy. Superseded inventory OR/24/047 remains historical.
decisions.mechanism: Narrow Bayat2011 colemanite-bearing ore fungal leaching; no percentage recovery, kinetic constant, pure product or broad-borate extrapolation.

decisions.identity: Explicit EU qualified designation, not an alias for boron element or all borates.
decisions.designation: EU original Annex I 1(c) verified. Recital 8 covers preceding stages toward specified grade.
decisions.missing: A sufficient material/product specification or official scope definition distinguishing metallurgy-grade boron from broad boron/borates. Annex label alone does not supply composition, impurity or acceptance specification. Official 2025 factsheet link returned 429 on two direct attempts and web internal error. No invented threshold or elemental identifier.

primary_studies.title: Bio-chemical leaching of kaolinite-hematite-boehmite type bauxite ore
primary_studies.status: full PDF read; mechanism not accepted
primary_studies.locators: Experimental pp.248-249; Table1-2 p250; Figure2 and Table3 p251; conclusion pp251-252. Table2 visually checked.
primary_studies.reason: Mixes selected consortia with purified Bacillus aryabhattai identification without unambiguous experiment assignment. No clear uninoculated control or total microbial exposure duration/replication. Table2 uses assumed nonleached reference constituents, including reported zeros that are assumptions rather than measurements; headline approximately50% Al2O3 extraction is not reproduced by the displayed table. Chemical-acid comparison differs in temperature. No yield or causal mechanism transferred.
primary_studies.supplement: No supplementary item referenced in inspected PDF; no exhaustive repository assertion.

primary_studies.title: Use of Aspergillus niger in the bioleaching of colemanite for the production of boric acid
primary_studies.status: full PDF plus HTML read; narrow mechanism accepted
primary_studies.locators: Methods pp3-4, Table1 p3; Figure1 p5, Figures2-3 p6, Table3 p7, Figure4 p8; all these assay plots/tables visually inspected.
primary_studies.supports: Growing reported ATCC11414 culture with mixed colemanite ore; 0.45um filtrate volumetry for boric acid and HPLC acids. Culture acidification differs from no-organism control and soluble boron was reported.
limits: No abiotic boron-release series in Table3, so microbial incremental dissolution unresolved.
Methods30±2C versus abstract/optimum25±2C; initial pH5.5 versus7/7.06; 5% endpoint Table3pH4.50 vs text4.10 and optimum4.60.
Figure4 line y=0.111x-0.030 but text k=0.030/day, which conflicts with slope interpretation. No fitted constant accepted.
No isolated product assay; solution release is not recovery of purified boric acid.
No numerical extraction accepted; calculated90.18% and12.95g/L B2O3 do not directly agree with50g/L feed times28.05% B2O3 without further explanation.
Organic-acid cause plausible, not exclusive demonstrated molecular route. Chemical comparator80C90min differs from culture assay.
At least duplicate, claimed reproducibility within5%; no raw replicates supplied.
primary_studies.supplement: No separately linked supplement observed in inspected primary PDF/HTML.

primary_studies.title: Bioleaching of the α-alumina layer of spent three-way catalysts as a pretreatment for the recovery of platinum group metals
primary_studies.status: Full primary PDF read; no alumina mechanism accepted
primary_studies.locators: Methods2.1-2.6 pp2-3; Results3.4 pp5-7; Fig4 p6 visually checked; AppendixA supplement reference p10.
primary_studies.scope: Cryomilled spent automotive catalyst, A.thiooxidans DSM11478, 14day assays30C150rpm; acid mixtures from different culture ages/pH compared to commercial acid. Total-element Al measurement in mixed cordierite/alumina feed does not isolate Al2O3 dissolution or produce alumina.
primary_studies.counterevidence: Stationary-phase advantage only at5% loading; at30/60% bacteria-free medium highest Al release. InitialpH differences confound attribution. Main text54.5% versus economic discussion57.1%; no economic/product claim accepted.
primary_studies.supplement: Publisher access403; appendix supplementary files not acquired. Public Mendeley DOI10.17632/c96gpb6zpm.1 (23January2024, CC BY4.0) metadata checked. HTML initial file list empty/loading; attempted public file endpoint404. Raw data and supplement remain unverified, not inferred absent.
